purpose: Frozen cross-sequence frontend accuracy validation; not leaderboard or online claim
taxonomy: native nuScenes 16, archived top1 label and confidence
cache_interpretation: zero-inference-latency mechanism control only; not online performance

gate.off_path: same inputs must preserve geometry/covariance in controlled integration tests
gate.state_coupling: semantic rows must update pose and cross-correlated velocity, and be included in covariance
gate.causality: old map frozen during all current-state iterations; no current/future observations
gate.data: raw point index carried through exact scan timing/sorting; identical IMU/images/geometry in all arms
gate.dataset: all arms retain all supported pose timestamps; report short-sequence errors without selecting a winner
gate.expansion: require stable boundary support, reduced local error beyond repeat spread, and no failures before longer runs

selection: first 240 frames of the other archived sequence, fixed without viewing revised frontend errors
independence: unseen by frontend implementation/diagnostics; archived segmentation evaluations have used seq09 previously

decision.benefit: all three paired full_B0 minus geometry ATE differences negative, nonoverlapping ATE ranges, and mean translation/rotation RPE no worse than geometry
decision.mechanism: boundary rows accepted on at least 80% of semantic updates
decision.failure: any missing/nonfinite trajectory, unequal timestamps, unchanged-zero constraints, or metric regression is reported; no parameter search
decision.scope: pass applies only to this short held-out frontend window; no large experiment auto-launched
decision.boundary_increment: report full_B0 against association_B0 separately; activation alone cannot prove useful boundary information
